source_name: BQK list of licensed financial institutions (PDF) — actor-map seed for this cell
why_relevant: Authoritative, periodically reissued roster of every licensed bank, MFI, insurer and payment institution. Not itself an events/awards source, but it is the canonical seed list for enumerating whose careers pages, internship schemes, conference sponsorships and award entries must be tracked in this cell.

source_name: FIKS — Fintech Kosovo cluster (LinkedIn signal via Kosovo Investment and Finance Network / KIFN)
why_relevant: Launch post names the fintech cluster's founding members (Numarics, OneFor, Paysera, Swinto) — a ready-made actor list of Kosovo payments/fintech employers whose LinkedIn pages and hiring posts should each be tracked.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — LinkedIn page
why_relevant: Fast, photo-caption-rich channel for event and training announcements, often earlier than the website, and the tagging of attendees exposes individual bank staff with current titles. Best used as a discovery pointer to canonical posts on bankassoc-kos.com rather than as a scraped source.

source_name: SHBK — Anëtarët / Member Banks directory
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every commercial bank operating in Kosovo (Banka Ekonomike, BKT, Banka për Biznes, Credins, Isbank, NLB, PriBank, ProCredit, Raiffeisen, TEB...). This is the seed actor list from which all bank-level career pages, leadership pages and hiring feeds are derived.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association member directory and member profiles
why_relevant: STIKK covers 100+ members and ~60% of Kosovo's ICT labour market; member profiles state each firm's specialisation and association memberships (e.g. Panamic ICT is described as a member of payments and banking associations in Kosovo). This is the single best enumerable list of local integrators that could be partnering with banks/PSPs — the actor map for the whole cell.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — tiered member directories (Patron / Corporate / Medium / Small)
why_relevant: Four tiered directories enumerate hundreds of companies active in Kosovo including banks, insurers, IT vendors and consultancies. Tier is itself a crude size/spend signal, and the directory is a ready-made vendor/partner actor list for the payments ecosystem.

source_name: AMIK — Anëtarët e AMIK (member MFIs directory) and Governance
why_relevant: Enumerates the licensed microfinance institutions and NBFIs in Kosovo — the second tier of credit providers alongside the banks, and a distinct hiring market. The Governance page names the board and executive director (Shpresim Vranovci, ED since 2022).

source_name: Media Ownership Monitor Kosovo
why_relevant: Directory of Kosovo media outlets including Serbian-language ones, with ownership and language metadata. The fastest way to enumerate the full sr-language outlet universe for this cell rather than discovering them one search at a time.

source_name: Media Ownership Monitor Kosovo (kosovo.mom-gmr.org)
why_relevant: A structured directory of Kosovo outlets with their ownership, reach and legal entities. It is the single best snowballing instrument for this cell: it enumerates outlets beyond the seven named in the brief and, critically, reveals owner-bank or owner-politician ties that must weight each outlet's credibility score on banking-governance stories.

source_name: Kosovo Judicial Council portal (gjyqesori-rks.org) — court network and case statistics
why_relevant: Central entry point to all Basic Courts, the Court of Appeals and their verdict repositories, plus caseload statistics including employment-dispute backlogs. Pointer for expanding judicial collection beyond Prishtina to Prizren, Peja, Gjilan, Mitrovica.

source_name: PTK / Posta e Kosovës & Vala — state postal-financial and telecom payment channels
why_relevant: Post and Telecom of Kosovo operates postal payment/remittance counters and (historically) the Vala mobile brand — postal and telecom operators are payments employers in their own right (bill payment, mobile money, agent networks) and, as public enterprises, must publish vacancies and board appointments officially. Establishes the actor; official vacancy channels should then be scouted on postakosoves.com / kosovotelecom.com.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of banks in Kosovo / Banking in Kosovo
why_relevant: Low-credibility but useful actor-map seed: enumerates licensed banks, ownership and official/alias names in en and sq, which drives glossary building and ensures no bank in the cell is missed as ownership changes.

source_name: Commercial registry-extract providers for Kosovo (Schmidt & Schmidt, Creditreform, theKYB, businessdataguide)
why_relevant: Paid intermediaries that obtain official ARBK extracts (current and historical) in Albanian or English, including officer and shareholder detail. They are the practical fallback when a legally-defensible, dated extract of a director change is needed and self-service search is insufficient; their product pages also document exactly which fields the official extract contains.

source_name: Dun & Bradstreet business directory — vendor legal entities registered in Kosovo (e.g. PRINTEC L.L.C., Prishtinë)
why_relevant: Confirms which international banking-technology vendors have actually incorporated a Kosovo entity (vs. serving remotely) and often names local executives and employee counts — the cheapest way to build the vendor actor map before searching for their announcements.

source_name: Enterprise Europe Network — partnering-opportunity notices from Kosovo cybersecurity/IT firms
why_relevant: EEN profiles are self-filed by Kosovo suppliers seeking outsourcing/supplier agreements and describe their capabilities, target sectors and partnering intent. It surfaces small local security vendors that never appear in press coverage but do sell penetration testing and compliance work into banks.

source_name: Expat.com - Job Portals in Kosovo (directory)
why_relevant: Maintained directory of Kosovo job portals. Cheap periodic check for boards that appear or die - useful because this segment churns and a dead board silently creates a coverage hole.

entity_name: Faculty of Economics, University of Priština
source_name: Faculty of Economics, University of Priština (Kosovska Mitrovica) — faculty news and cooperation announcements (sr)
why_relevant: The Serbian-language economics faculty serving northern Kosovo; its internship agreements, guest lectures and graduate placements are the sr-side equivalent of the UP Prishtina career centre. The faculty's own domain was not confirmed in this pass, so this directory entry is recorded as a pointer to reach it.

source_name: Finance Think — Economic Research and Policy Institute, Skopje
why_relevant: Named seed think tank; publishes labour-market and financial-sector studies for North Macedonia and occasionally the wider region. No Kosovo banking-people output was observed, so treat as a low-yield pointer to regional research networks.

source_name: InHunt World — Kosovo headhunting partner page
why_relevant: Open-web (non-LinkedIn) directory of the local executive-search partner for Kosovo — useful as a scrapeable proxy for the recruiter layer that is otherwise trapped behind LinkedIn's auth wall.

source_name: MoneyGram agent locator — Kosovo
why_relevant: Enumerates MoneyGram agent/partner outlets in Kosovo. The agent list is an indirect census of which Kosovo entities (banks, exchange bureaus, retail chains, MFIs) operate payments businesses and therefore staff payments roles — a way to discover employers not named in any register search.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — Open Businesses
why_relevant: Civil-society open-data project built on the ARBK register; a route to historical bulk snapshots and to the people/organisations who have already solved Kosovo registry parsing. Pointer to further datasets and to the state of registry openness.

source_name: Privredna komora Srbije — Kosovo-related entrepreneur associations / parlament privrednika
why_relevant: PKS registers entrepreneur associations from Serb-majority Kosovo municipalities and seats their representatives in its parliament of entrepreneurs, so its registries and board pages name Kosovo-based business figures under a Serbian institutional frame.

source_name: The Banker Database (FT) — bank profiles and rankings incl. SEE banks
why_relevant: FT-owned structured database of bank financials and profiles used for Top-1000/regional rankings; supports identification of Kosovo-relevant banks and their parent groups, and The Banker's editorial covers CEO profiles and appointments.

source_name: TheOfficialBoard / CB Insights — executive org-chart aggregators
why_relevant: Crowd/vendor-maintained org charts for NLB Banka Prishtina and Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo. Low authority and often stale, but occasionally surfaces mid-level structural roles absent from official pages; treat as lead-generation only.

source_name: Vendor partner-locator directories (Worldline business partners, Kemp partner finder, and equivalents at NCR Atleos / Verifone / Diebold Nixdorf)
why_relevant: Global vendors publish searchable partner directories with country filters. Filtering these on Kosovo/XK enumerates the authorised local resellers and integrators for payments, ATM and security hardware — the practical substitute for a non-existent public procurement trail.
